_**Agent (default)**_


这里不能替你输入 sudo 密码，你可以用下面两种方式之一安装：

**方式一：在你自己终端里执行（需要输入密码）**
```bash
sudo npm i -g @openai/codex
```

**方式二：不用 sudo，把全局包装到用户目录**

1. 设置全局安装目录（只需做一次）：
```bash
mkdir -p ~/.npm-global
npm config set prefix ~/.npm-global
```

2. 把该目录加入 PATH（放到 `~/.bashrc` 或 `~/.zshrc`）：
```bash
export PATH="$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$PATH"
```
然后执行 `source ~/.bashrc` 或 `source ~/.zshrc`。

3. 再安装：
```bash
npm i -g @openai/codex
```

装好后可用 `codex --version` 或 `which codex` 确认是否在 PATH 里。

The user is showing a terminal error: `ENOTEMPTY` when trying to install @openai/codex globally with sudo. The error says the directory `/usr/local/lib/node_modules/@openai/codex` exists and npm can't rename it (to a temp path) because the destination is not empty.

This usually happens when:
1. A previous install left a broken/partial state
2. The existing @openai/codex folder has conflicting content

The fix is to remove the existing installation first, then reinstall:

```bash
sudo rm -rf /usr/local/lib/node_modules/@openai/codex
sudo npm i -g @openai/codex
```

Or remove the whole @openai folder if that's the only package:
```bash
sudo rm -rf /usr/local/lib/node_modules/@openai
sudo npm i -g @openai/codex
```

_**Agent (default)**_


`ENOTEMPTY` 一般是之前安装留下了不完整或冲突的目录，npm 在更新时无法重命名。

先删掉旧安装再重装，在你自己的终端里执行：

```bash
sudo rm -rf /usr/local/lib/node_modules/@openai/codex
sudo npm i -g @openai/codex
```

如果还有报错，可以连整个 `@openai` 目录一起删再装：

```bash
sudo rm -rf /usr/local/lib/node_modules/@openai
sudo npm i -g @openai/codex
```
